items.title: John L. Jones Interview, 1972-06-05
items.q: He used to call me up on the telephone. I used to listen to him play his banjo. Over the telephone.

ctx.x: I did a fella to play it too.
What about Lemon? Did he ever play a youth band?
Oh Lemon, when I met, I met Lemon in a race in Louisiana. I met with a guitar. Yeah, he told me he played guitar and banjo.
